run_3dbox_evaluation: run the EvalQuery3dbox evaluation on a checkpoint folder to compute 3D bounding box IoU metrics
compute_bbox_iou_3d: compute the intersection over union of two 3D axis-aligned bounding boxes
compute_bbox_iou_3d_batch: compute pairwise IoU between two sets of 3D axis-aligned bounding boxes in batch
evaluate_3dpoint_query: evaluate 3D bounding box retrieval using nearest Gaussian point to a sampled 3D query location
evaluate_2davg_query: evaluate 3D bounding box retrieval using averaged 2D features from training images
